end_dots.definition: eligible detected dots within 35 A of a rods_analysed rod end point (centre +/- (h + offset) u); shift null = each rod moved 150-300 A, NREP replicates

averages_method: per-stratum average of each 2D class: own-CTF phase flip, script-17 pose/shift convention (rot -theta, shift -, particle frame), contrast sign from conventions.json, Fourier-cropped to the CS class-average grid and windowed (class2D_window_inner_A, 10 A cosine edge); hole test = scripts/41 describe() on strata with >= 300 particles; lenient = z>1.5 mask, hole >= 20 A
